method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Nasdaq 100 Drops 3% as Risk-Off Dominates With Oil Prices Rising
Equities.reason: Large tech-led decline and explicit 'risk-off' framing — signals a strong negative equity regime shift, with oil-driven risk premium adding to market stress. High relevance to broad equity risk sentiment.

Equities.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq end sharply lower as revived AI doubts ignite tech selloff
Equities.reason: Direct confirmation that renewed AI skepticism is triggering broad-tech weakness and market-wide declines — central to the prevailing equity narrative (AI leadership under pressure).

Equities.title: Stock Market News, Oct. 22, 2026: Tech Selloff Deepens as Flight Into Treasurys Drives Yields Lower
Equities.reason: Cross-market transmission: equity selling tied to safe-haven Treasury demand and falling yields. Important because it links equity risk-off to bond-market flows and liquidity dynamics.

Equities.title: China Stocks Sink Further as State Buying Offers Little Relief
Equities.reason: Significant China equity weakness despite state support — reinforces global risk-off backdrop and reduces risk appetite for cyclicals and EM-linked flows.

Equities.title: Meta stock sinks nearly 7% as AI spend pushes free cash flow negative
Equities.summary: Prices for the social media giant's five-year credit default swaps are reaching all-time highs as investors signal growing credit concerns.
Equities.reason: Large-cap tech (Meta) pain tied explicitly to AI capex and cash-flow concerns — meaningful because Meta is a market leader and its stress propagates to the AI trade and the broader tech complex.

Equities.title: China AI Model Stocks’ $150 Billion Drop Shows No Sign of Easing
Equities.reason: Reinforces the AI-theme unwind in a major market (China) — adds to evidence that AI leadership is under pressure globally, amplifying equity downside risk.

Equities.title: Rapid Junk Rout Amplifies Arini’s Losses and Erases Sona’s Gains
Equities.reason: Credit-market stress (junk rout) is feeding equity volatility and risk-off dynamics — supportive of a broader deleveraging/flight-to-quality narrative that pressures stocks.

Equities.title: Winter arrives in markets
Equities.summary: Bonds and stocks tell the same chilly story
Equities.reason: Macro-synthesis piece: both bond and equity markets pointing to a 'chilly' regime. Useful to weight the broader market regime (risk-off, lower risk appetite) rather than idiosyncratic moves.

Equities.title: Moderna shares plunge after cancer vaccine data leaks — despite positive results
Equities.summary: Moderna released full data on its closely watched cancer vaccine developed with Merck.
Equities.reason: Large single-stock move driven by leaked clinical data. Relevant as a near-term volatility driver and illustrative of risk-off 'sell-the-news' dynamics, but idiosyncratic compared with the AI/tech-led market regime.

Rates.title: 10-year Treasury yield tumbles below 5% to lowest level in nearly a month
Rates.summary: Treasury yields dove dramatically lower on Thursday as investors monitored a slump in stocks and surging oil prices.
Rates.reason: Clear, market-moving drop in US Treasury yields -> bond-price positive. Reflects broad haven demand and materially eases rate front-end/term premium pressures; high relevance to global rates and positioning.

Rates.title: Treasuries’ Link to AI Shows Sharp Shift as Haven Trade Returns
Rates.reason: Narrative connecting tech/AI-driven equity selloff to renewed Treasury haven flows — supports a meaningful bond rally and lower yields; important thematic driver for moves in USTs.

Rates.title: Japan's core inflation exceeds BOJ target, cements near-term rate hike chance
Rates.reason: Higher-than-target core CPI raises odds of BOJ tightening -> upward pressure on JGB yields (negative for bond prices). Material regional policy risk that can influence global rate differentials and flow.

Rates.title: Japanese Bond Yields Fall as AI Jitters Spur Haven Demand
Rates.reason: JGB yields falling due to global risk-off/haven flows reinforces the cross-market bond rally narrative; supports lower yields and tighter global term premia despite local inflation headline.

Rates.title: Traders’ Cost of Hedging Against Big Treasuries Rally Is Soaring
Rates.reason: Rising hedging costs indicate strong demand and positioning for a Treasury rally but also signal crowded trades and potential for volatile reversals; supportive for near-term bond prices with caveats on risk.

FX.title: Japanese Yen retreats from one-month top vs recovering USD as focus remains on Fed and BoJ
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair rebounds from an over one-month low, around the 156.00 neighborhood touched during the Asian session earlier this Friday following the release of Japan's consumer inflation figures.
FX.reason: USD/JPY rebound signals near-term USD strength vs JPY tied to Fed/BoJ focus and Japan inflation; meaningful for FX as JPY is a major funding/safe-haven currency. Relevance raised for central-bank-driven moves and cross-market flows.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index struggles due to weak tech earnings
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is remaining subdued for the fourth successive day and trading near 101.60 during Asian hours on Friday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY move: softening DXY implies broad USD weakness vs majors (EUR/JPY/GBP/AUD etc). High relevance because DXY is the primary USD gauge and tech earnings are driving risk/currency flows.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar advances as US Dollar weakens on tech earnings, Middle East risk aversion
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its losing streak for the seventh successive day, trading around 1.4000 during Asian hours on Friday. The pair has depreciated as the US Dollar (USD) struggles under pressure from mounting doubts regarding the sustainability of the AI trade.
FX.reason: USD/CAD losing streak reflects broad USD softness and CAD strength (risk/commodity and cross-border flows). Relevant as CAD is a major USD pair and oil/Middle East risk can drive FX flows.

FX.title: Euro edges higher as USD selling remains unabated; France's debt worries cap gains
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair builds on the overnight bounce from sub-1.1200 levels and attracts some follow-through buying during the Asian session on Friday. Spot prices, however, remain confined within a one-week-old range, currently trading around the 1.1225 area amid
FX.reason: EUR/USD strength amid USD selling is a core FX narrative; France sovereign risk caps upside which moderates but does not negate the EUR move. High relevance given EUR's weight in DXY and regional sovereign implications.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Softens to near 1.1200, sub-100-day SMA keep outlook bearish
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades in negative territory around 1.1210 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Worries about France's ability to tackle its huge debt burden have hurt French government bonds and exert some selling pressure on the Euro (EUR) aga
FX.reason: Technical/forecast piece: bearish EUR outlook tied to French debt stress implies USD strength. Relevance capped due to technical focus (price-forecast), but still feeds EUR downside narrative.

FX.title: Euro: Range trading intact near recent lows against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank strategists (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report that EUR/USD outperformed modestly as the US Dollar (USD) softened, but price action remains choppy and largely directionless.
FX.reason: Bank strategist note emphasizing choppy EUR/USD and modest EUR outperformance as USD softens. Useful as color on limited follow-through; relevance moderate given bank research perspective.

FX.title: Swiss Franc inches lower as US Dollar recovers recent losses
FX.summary: USD/CHF holds ground after three days of losses, trading around 0.8210 during Asian hours on Friday. The currency pair has inched higher as the US Dollar (USD) recovers its daily losses despite mounting doubts regarding the sustainability of the AI trade.
FX.reason: USD recovery vs CHF points to renewed USD strength/safety-bias dynamics; CHF is a key funding/safe-haven currency so moves merit moderate relevance.

FX.title: Australian Dollar losses steam at 0.7000 as PMIs signal a deceleration
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar retreats 0.17% against the US Dollar on Thursday as sentiment soured on US tech stocks falling on worries about AI valuations, while Oil surged on an escalation of the US-Iran conflict. The AUD/USD trades at 0.7017.
FX.reason: AUD weakness vs USD driven by weaker PMIs and risk/commodity dynamics; AUD is a major dollar pair so this contributes to the cross-asset USD/risk narrative. Moderate relevance due to mixed drivers.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar gains ground to near 0.5700 on RBNZ rate hike prospects
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair gathers strength to around 0.5690 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. Growing expectations of a Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) rate hike provide some support to the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Rate-hike expectations supporting NZD vs USD is a clear FX-native transmission (carry/yield differentials). Relevant to USD-basket given policy-driven flows in small major currencies.

FX.title: Indian Rupee wipes out weekly gains as oil prices continue to rise
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee extends Thursday’s weakness against the US Dollar (USD) in Friday, wiping out almost entire gains made earlier this week. The USD/INR pair jumps to near 94.92 as surging oil prices due to Middle East tensions have weighed heavily on the Indian
FX.reason: Rupee weakness driven by higher oil (import shock) and Middle East risks implies USD strength vs INR. Country-specific but relevant because oil-driven EM FX moves can amplify USD demand.

FX.title: Mexican Peso nears 18.75 as Iran risks and AI selloff hit sentiment
FX.summary: The Mexican Peso depreciated for the second straight day, down 0.16%, as the US Dollar held firm amid growing tensions in the Middle East and investor fears that mega tech companies are issuing more debt to finance the AI buildout. The USD/MXN trades at 18.72,
FX.reason: USD/MXN holding firm amid risk and geopolitical tensions points to USD strength; relevant regionally and for EM FX flows but lower than G10 moves.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah strengthens against US Dollar as safe-haven demand shifts
FX.summary: USD/IDR inches lower after two days of gains, trading around 18,110 during Asian hours on Friday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) struggles amid mounting doubts regarding the sustainability of the AI trade.
FX.reason: IDR gains as USD softens amid AI-sustainability doubts; EM FX reaction to USD moves is relevant but should carry lower weight than majors.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Gradual gains toward 6.6640 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note USD/CNH is drifting lower, with intraday risks skewed toward a brief dip below 6.6700, though they do not expect a sustained break.
FX.reason: CNH drifting lower (yuan gains) reflects managed/market pressures vs USD. Relevant because China FX moves can influence broader EM and carry flows; bank note increases credibility but expectation of limited break caps relevance.

FX.title: Philip R. Lane: Euro liquidity lines and the international monetary system
FX.reason: ECB commentary on euro liquidity lines and international monetary system is a high-impact policy/FX native item that can support EUR and change cross-border USD funding dynamics. High relevance assigned for systemic implications.

FX.title: French bond pain puts euro zone's weak links on notice
FX.reason: Sovereign bond stress in France increases Europe-specific tail risk and undermines the euro, leading to USD strength via safe-haven and funding-channel moves. Elevated relevance due to cross-market sovereign/FX transmission.

FX.title: Global tech sell-off sparks flight to safety
FX.summary: Japanese bonds and yen rally as Asian stock markets follow Wall Street lower
FX.reason: Flight-to-quality rally in JPY and Japanese bonds signals USD weakness vs JPY and broader risk-off FX dynamics. Relevant as it reflects cross-asset flows shifting into safe-haven currencies.

FX.title: Rupee Rally Faces Limits From India’s Oil and Dollar Problem
FX.reason: Headline indicates rupee upside constrained by oil and dollar strength — supports USD demand and EM FX pressure via commodity/import channels. Moderate relevance as country/commodity-specific but market-impacting for INR.

Commodities.reason: Reported increase in Venezuelan production adds tangible incremental supply — negative for oil price backdrop, offsets some geopolitical premia.

Commodities.title: Gold heads for steep weekly loss as oil prices fuel Fed rate concerns
Commodities.reason: Rising oil/inflation and resulting Fed-rate-hike repricing are pressuring gold — a broad, market-significant driver pushing gold lower this week.

Commodities.reason: Continued gold downside tied to macro risk-on dynamics, rate expectations and volatility — reinforces dominant negative tone for the metal.

Crypto.reason: A security-related delay for an Ethereum test undermines confidence in ETH protocol upgrades and increases short-term technical risk for ETH liquidity and developer trust — negative for ETH and altcoin sentiment.

Crypto.reason: Shows market re-risking toward BTC as a relative safe-haven amid altcoin weakness and uncertain ETF flows — supportive for BTC dominance and ETF-driven liquidity.

Crypto.reason: Continued ETF inflows are a constructive institutional-demand signal for BTC, but the article tempers expectations for a strong, immediate price impulse.

Crypto.title: Senate's top Democratic investigator looking into Tether payments to Bo Hines' firm

Crypto.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines

Crypto.reason: A plan to shorten settlement should improve ETH utility and onchain capital efficiency, supporting longer-term adoption and reducing friction costs — positive for ETH/market structure.

Crypto.title: Solana’s biggest network change since 2020 is live. Here’s how users benefit
Crypto.reason: A major Solana upgrade improves chain capabilities and user experience; constructive for Solana-specific demand though limited market-wide impact.
